sources.content: Rahul promised to send the revised proposal after finance approves the budget, by Friday.
From Rahul: finance approved the budget; I will send the revised proposal by Friday.
After receiving Rahul's proposal, I will review it and forward it to the placement team.
The placement team has not acknowledged the proposal yet.
If the placement team does not acknowledge the proposal, I will follow up on Monday.
Professor Mehta must approve the design before I submit the final report.
The final report is ready to submit once Professor Mehta approves the design.
The research office receives the final report after submission.
I emailed HR asking for the interview schedule on Monday.
From HR: the interview schedule will be sent tomorrow; no schedule has been attached yet.
I will contact HR next Friday if the interview schedule remains missing.
Rahul sent the proposal yesterday and I forwarded it to the team today.
The old commitment to call Rahul about the proposal was cancelled.
The replacement commitment is to email Rahul about the proposal on Monday.
Renew the gym membership in December; it is unrelated to the research report.
Professor Mehta confirmed approval of the design on Tuesday.
The project team is the recipient for the forwarded proposal.
There is no local record about contacting the bank regarding a mortgage.
